rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose way to refer to someone who climbs mountains for sport or pleasure.

example.english: My friend is a mountaineer and often asks me to go mountain climbing on holidays.
example.traditional: 我朋友係爬山嘅人，放假成日約我去爬山。
example.jyutping: ngo5 pang4 jau5 hai6 paa4 saan1 ge3 jan4 fong3 gaa3 seng4 jat6 joek3 ngo5 heoi3 paa4 saan1

rows.note: Use this more formal term when referring specifically to a mountaineer, especially in written or technical contexts.

example.english: The report said that mountaineer successfully reached the summit.
example.traditional: 報道話，嗰位登山者成功征服咗高峰。
example.jyutping: bou3 dou6 waa6 go2 wai6 dang1 saan1 ze2 sing4 gung1 zing1 fuk6 zo2 gou1 fung1
